feed.subtitle: PhD Researcher in Advanced Control Systems at Nantes Université, École Centrale de Nantes / LS2N, France. My research focuses on sliding mode control (SMC), adaptive control, and observer design for floating offshore wind turbines (FOWTs), with applications in renewable energy systems. I work on data-driven control methods, neural network-based adaptive controllers, and second-order sliding mode observers, validated through OpenFAST co-simulation with MATLAB/Simulink. I collaborate with University of Pavia (Italy) and BTU Cottbus (Germany).
